description: This Java source file defines the TipsAdapter class, an adapter for a RecyclerView that displays various tip messages based on different Throwable exceptions encountered. It manages a list of TipsModel objects, maps exceptions to specific user tips, and creates view holders for displaying individual tips.

classes.name: TipsAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for RecyclerView that displays various tips or error messages based on exceptions encountered in the application.

methods.name: TipsAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a listener for action button clicks.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new TipsViewHolder for a given view type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a TipsModel from the list to the view holder at a specific position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of tips currently stored.

methods.name: setThrowables
methods.description: Processes a list of Throwable objects, mapping each to appropriate tips based on exception type, and updates the tips list.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a tip message with optional intent to the tips list.
